# BDRetailers / Webmaa / Daripallah

> BDRetailers (Webmaa / Daripallah) is Bangladesh's premier AI-powered white-label e-commerce SaaS platform and multi-vendor marketplace. It enables merchants, retailers, and entrepreneurs in Bangladesh to build, launch, and manage custom online stores in less than 1 minute.

## Core Features & Capabilities

- **Instant Store Creation**: Launch a full-fledged Bangladeshi online store with customized domain, branding, logo, and banner in 60 seconds.
- **AI Companion & Smart Assistant**: Built-in AI companion for product cataloging, automated descriptions, smart inventory management, and customer support.
- **Couriers & Payment Gateways**: Automated integration with Steadfast Courier, UddoktaPay, PipraPay, Bkash, Nagad, and Cash on Delivery (COD).
- **Free 1-Month Trial**: 30-day free trial for all new merchants to test all premium features with zero commitment.
- **Mobile Apps & PWA**: Automated mobile application builds (Android APK / iOS) for white-label retail shop owners.
- **Smart Fraud Detection**: Integrated Bangladesh enterprise fraud detection engine to identify fake orders and delivery risks.

## Target Audience

- Retailers, Shop Owners, Wholesalers, and E-commerce Merchants in Bangladesh (Dhaka, Chittagong, Rajshahi, Khulna, Sylhet, Rangpur, etc.).
- Small business owners looking for Shopify alternatives tailored for Bangladeshi Taka (BDT) and local couriers.
